notes: Make disc-info.json the authoritative Library metadata source and shrink SQLite to a disposable search index containing only title, UPC/EAN and exact manifest path plus internal timestamps.
Read the selected item's current JSON directly from disk every time its Library popup opens, so year, duration, codecs, extras and other details cannot become stale database copies.
Keep bulk-imported owned UPCs that do not yet have manifests in a separate minimal owned_upcs table; automatically remove one when a matching manifest is indexed.
Make Check manifests rebuild/repair the tiny index and remove stale index entries whose manifests are no longer present.
